items.evidence: AC#1 acceptance passes and asserts 36 ranges in APPLICABLE_LINES order, justifications, and the three exact problem lists. Holdout: 36 entries, file justification 141 words; validator also returns the exact spec texts for bad format (alone), unknown size, short file justification, non-applicable BB limp, duplicate key, invalid token (KAs) and collects all 7 problems at once; defaultRange absent -> 'Ranges 6-max have no range CO limp'.

AC#2 acceptance passes (spy called once, one range equal to an independently built expansion, length = sum comboCount - dead). Holdout with a different button (4) and two live opponents: CO open-raise start equals my own expansion of the authored hands minus dead cards (211 combos), spy gets ranges in seat order, HJ limper-then-caller keyed call-raise, combos == start when the opponent has not acted on the flop.

AC#3 passes. Holdout: fixture classes strong,strong,pair,pair,draw,draw,air,air; bet -> KhKd,8h7h,AhKh,9h9d,6h5h,Th9h; input order preserved on a reversed range. Independent classifier agreed with product on 75,750 (combo, board) pairs, 0 mismatches (random, paired/two-pair/trips/quads, flush, straight, straight-flush, full-house, wheel and broadway boards, plus exhaustive combos on 14 special boards).
AC#4 passes. Holdout: check -> AhKh,9h9d,6h5h,Th9h,QhJh,Ac2c; KEEP table matches spec; narrowRange equals my KEEP+classifier filter on 1,200 random range/board/action cases.
AC#5 passes. Holdout: call -> AhKh,9h9d,6h5h,Th9h; raise -> KhKd,8h7h,6h5h,Th9h.
AC#6 passes. Holdout: check on Ks 8d 7c then call on +2d -> AhKh,9h9d,6h5h,Th9h,Ac2c; turn classes give Ac2c pair, QhJh air.
